## Q1
What is the average of the number of students scoring 50 or more but less than 60 marks in Punjabi and in Hindi?

| Marks (out of 100) | Cumulative percentage of Hindi and Punjabi students | Cumulative number of Hindi students |
|---|---|---|
| 80 and above | 15% | 108 |
| 70 and above | 35% | 264 |
| 60 and above | 65% | 424 |
| 50 and above | 90% | 554 |
| 40 and above | 100% | 624 |

Marks-wise distribution of students. Total students: 1200; no student failed; each student appeared in either Hindi or Punjabi.

## Q1 - Options
(A) 180
(B) 150
(C) 200
(D) 140

## Q1 - Hint
**Answer:** B
**Topic:** Data Interpretation
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q1

The combined 50–60 group is 300. Hindi contributes 554 − 424 = 130, so Punjabi contributes 170; their average is (130 + 170) ÷ 2 = 150. Therefore, 150 is the correct choice. The Hindi and Punjabi student counts must be subtracted from the cumulative distribution before averaging.

## Q2 - Options

(B) 16
(C) 14
(D) 30

## Q2 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Data Interpretation
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q2

The combined 70–80 group is 240; Hindi has 156, leaving 84 Punjabi students. Hindi has 624 − 554 = 70 in 40–50, so the difference is 14. Therefore, 14 is the correct choice. The required Hindi and Punjabi groups are obtained by subtracting adjacent cumulative student counts.

## Q6
Standard deviation (S) and coefficient of variation (CV, as a percentage) are given below. Compute each mean and arrange them in ascending order.

A. S = 4, CV = 40/9<br>
B. S = 5, CV = 62.5<br>
C. S = 14, CV = 70/3<br>
D. S = 16, CV = 160/7

Choose the correct answer.

## Q6 - Options
(A) B, A, C, D
(B) C, D, B, A
(C) A, D, B, C
(D) D, B, C, A

## Q6 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Research Aptitude
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q6

Using CV = S/mean × 100 gives means B = 8, A = 36, C = 60, and D = 70. Their ascending order is B, A, C, D. Therefore, B, A, C, D is the correct choice. The standard deviation and coefficient of variation determine every dataset mean through the stated formula.

## Q12
Which is the correct sequence of increasing access time of storage/memory devices?

A. Magnetic tape<br>
B. RAM<br>
C. Cache memory<br>
D. Hard disk<br>
E. Registers

## Q12 - Options
(A) A, B, C, D, E
(B) B, E, C, A, D
(C) E, C, B, D, A
(D) C, E, B, A, D

## Q12 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** ICT (Computers, Internet, Terminology)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q12

Registers are fastest, followed by cache, RAM, hard disk, and magnetic tape. Thus the increasing access-time sequence is E, C, B, D, A. Therefore, E, C, B, D, A is the correct choice.

## Q19
When a producer allows 36% commission on the retail price, the profit is 8.8%. What is the profit if commission is reduced by 24%?

## Q19 - Options
(A) 36.6%
(B) 49.6%
(C) 59.6%
(D) 45.6%

## Q19 - Hint
**Answer:** B
**Topic:** Mathematical Aptitude (Arithmetic)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q19

Take retail price as 100. Net receipt is 64 and equals 108.8% of cost, so cost is 58.82. At 12% commission the receipt is 88, giving (88−58.82)/58.82 = 49.6% profit. Therefore, 49.6% is the correct choice.

## Q23
Find the number replacing the question mark: 7, 12, 32, 122, ?, 3602, 25202.

## Q23 - Options
(A) 602
(B) 610
(C) 702
(D) 622

## Q23 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q23

Each step multiplies by successive integers and subtracts successive even numbers: 7×2−2=12, 12×3−4=32, 32×4−6=122, so 122×5−8=602. Therefore, 602 is the correct choice.

## Q32
A sum was put at simple interest for 3 years. At a rate 1% higher, it would have fetched ₹5,100 more. Find the sum.

## Q32 - Options
(A) ₹170,000
(B) ₹150,000
(C) ₹175,000
(D) ₹200,000

## Q32 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Mathematical Aptitude (Arithmetic)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q32

An extra 1% simple interest for 3 years equals 3% of principal. Hence 0.03P = 5,100, giving P = ₹170,000. Therefore, ₹170,000 is the correct choice. The simple-interest increase applies to the principal for three years at one percentage point.

(C) A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II
(D) A-I, B-IV, C-II, D-III

## Q36 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Research Aptitude
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q36

Population standard deviation is √(mean of squares − mean²): A = √36 = 6, B = √100 = 10, C = √81 = 9, and D = √16 = 4. Therefore, A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II is the correct choice. Each population standard deviation follows from the population mean and the mean of squared values.

## Q37

## Q37 - Options
(A) 15, 12, 12, 5, 8
(B) 5, 12, 12, 15, 8
(C) 8, 5, 12, 12, 15
(D) 12, 5, 12, 8, 15

## Q37 - Hint
**Answer:** A

**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q37

The code writes the alphabetical positions in reverse order. HELLO has positions 8, 5, 12, 12, 15, so the reversed sequence is 15, 12, 12, 5, 8. Therefore, 15, 12, 12, 5, 8 is the correct choice.

## Q42
Which are differences between the Modified Mercalli Scale (MMS) and Richter Scale (RS)?

## Q43
If “No birds are animals” is false, which statements can be inferred true?

A. Some animals are not birds.<br>
B. Some birds are not animals.<br>
C. Some animals are birds.<br>
D. Some birds are animals.

Choose the most appropriate answer.

## Q43 - Options
(A) A and B only
(B) C and D only
(C) B only
(D) A, B, C and D

## Q43 - Hint
**Answer:** B
**Topic:** Logical Reasoning (Venn, Syllogism, Arguments)
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q43

Negating “No birds are animals” yields “Some birds are animals.” This is equivalent to “Some animals are birds,” so C and D are both true. Therefore, C and D only is the correct choice.

## Q46
Which Act/section gives parents the right to seek relief from any kind of abuse?

Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions.

Forced by circumstances and in search of success and status, educated young men and women settle far away from their parents. Some go abroad. The very education that the parents manage to give to their children turns against them in the end. Their children go away in search of green pastures leaving them alone. International community as well as our government is aware of their problems. The UNO proclaimed the year 1999 as ‘International Year for the Aged’. In our own country too the year 2000 was proclaimed ‘The Year for the Aged’.

Article 41 of our constitution clearly makes it incumbent on the state to look after the aged. There is a social welfare ministry responsible for the welfare of the aged. Laws are made from time-to-time to protect the rights of senior citizens. For example under law parents cannot be evicted from a house without due process of law under section 105 of the Criminal Procedure Code. A magistrate can order a person to maintain his/her old parents under the Maintenance of Parents Act. The Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act says that the aged parents can demand maintenance from their children. The Domestic Violence Act also provides parents with the rights to seek relief from any kind of abuse.

## Q46 - Options
(A) Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act
(B) Section 105 of CPC
(C) The Domestic Violence Act
(D) Section 98 of CPC

## Q46 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Comprehension
**Source:** UGC NET Jun 2025 (26 Jun, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q46

The passage expressly states that the Domestic Violence Act provides parents the right to seek relief from abuse. The other provisions concern maintenance or eviction. Therefore, The Domestic Violence Act is the correct choice.
